cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: More Power, More Problems
cards.instruction: Celebrate every burden, restriction, or crisis as evidence that your influence is expanding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Another customer complaint about me! I'm becoming the focus of this hotel. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm taking you off reception while I investigate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Wonderful. Now management is organizing its day around me too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'll answer every complaint in writing from the laundry office.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My own correspondence operation, reaching into laundry. I'll need more paper.

mechanism: A treats complaints and restrictions as widening personal influence while cooperating with the manager practical conditions to sustain a confident command story.
confusable: Unlike strategic retreat alone, A celebrates increased reach rather than giving something up from strength; authority depends on accepting B imposed workflow.
comparison: Investigation and laundry office differ from cross-department room borrowing and a file trolley.
seedUse: Use D68-b complaints/reception removal/laundry writing with S02-b adapting behavior to keep management cooperation.
